input_timeseries.architecture_scope: Three wires through a schematic general QRC channel block; only the current scalar enters each update. Earlier inputs act through carried quantum state. The reset QELM receives the full explicit window through E(S_d), then fixed gates. Both models measure observables and apply a readout. The target readout is fixed (identity for the declared observable vector); only the emulator readout is trained. No specific topology or gate count is asserted.
input_timeseries.causal_scope: Only the selected scalar a_180 enters the QRC update; the reset-QELM receives exactly inputs 141..180. Grey samples 181..200 are future display context only and are supplied to neither model.
input_timeseries.figure_notation: Both general architectures show small gold readout triangles after their observable banks, without readout text labels. The output labels are Y_t and widehat Y_t and feed one analytic toy comparison; readout trainability and the fixed target remain specified in the caption and model text. O_1,...,O_m are model-specific schematic observable labels, not identical operators or an equal-budget claim. The numerical target readout remains the identity; actual feature counts and P_j notation are unchanged.
